verdict.rationale: WorkOS RBAC docs say developers can define custom roles, including organization-scoped ones, and assign permissions to them, configured in the Dashboard or via the API. Roles integrate with AuthKit, with access enforced through session JWTs, which covers defining, enforcing and surfacing roles in tokens. An old community note that RBAC 'wasn't available yet' predates these docs and does not contradict them. Missing for 10: detail on how roles and permissions appear as session-token claims and on SDK-side permission-check helpers, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
